text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Furioso. You eat some of this too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"They shoved it on me saying they made too 
much! Sheesh, what a pain in the ass."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
She's someone who knows how to step back 
gracefully. If you had declined on the 
spot, it would have ended without any hard 
feelings, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up!! Stuff like this happens! 
Sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You live by yourself, don'tcha?! You might 
as well take one home with ya, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Just one piece...? Well... ...Then please 
excuse me as I take one.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No way!! The whole thing! All of it! Just 
one piece!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Just take it already! Eat it with some 
white rice! Use it as a side dish, you 
dummy!
